verdict.line: You out-trade him every wave before level 6, but if he lands a knockup off cooldown with Ignite up, the 48.6% win rate over 1623 games shows that single read can erase your whole lead.

brief.thesis: Ornn has no gap-closer until E (Searing Charge) or R (Call of the Forge God), while your Q (Parrrley) hits at 625 range versus his E's 450 range and Q (Volcanic Rupture)'s 800-range but slow-only fissure — so you control every trade until he hits 6. Lane advantage is yours, but solo-kill advantage is his: once Searing Charge can collide with a wall for the shockwave knockup, or his ultimate elemental can be redirected into one, Ignite turns a single landed knockup into a kill.

theirWindow.what: If his E is up and you're standing near a wall, don't trade — Searing Charge's terrain collision shockwave knocks up, and once he's 6 he can follow with Call of the Forge God redirected into you for a second knockup plus Ignite burst.

yourWindow.when: Pre-6, his E and Q both down
yourWindow.what: Walk to 625 range and fire Parrrley — he has no answer to ranged poke before level 6, so punish every cooldown gap on Volcanic Rupture (9-7s) and Searing Charge (14-12s) for free damage.

powerCurve.note: Ranged Q poke, he has no gap-close

start.why: 50.2% win rate over 1247 games — the sustain and early AD let you win the poke trades Ornn can't contest before he has a dash.

boots.why: 54.6% win rate over 500 games — the lifesteal offsets the chip damage from Volcanic Rupture and his autos while you're walking up to Parrrley range.

core.why: Mana sustain lets you spam Parrrley every 5 seconds without running dry mid-trade.
His passive (Living Forge) grants him bonus armor from every item he forges — you need the penetration to keep Q damage relevant.
Highest-sample core path (50% win rate over 320 games) — crit scaling is where your late-game edge over him comes from.

situational.when: you're ahead and want Ignite + Q to cleanly execute him in the all-in window instead of surviving it
his Q poke is wearing you down faster than you're winning trades and you need sustain to hold lane
you need the extra dash/burst to punish a dead Searing Charge or Volcanic Rupture cooldown

runes.keystoneWhy: The burn stacks off every Parrrley land, stacking with your passive's poison to out-damage his sustain in extended trades without needing to all-in.

summoners.why: 77.5% pick rate at a 49.3% win rate — Ignite punishes his lack of sustain in the pre-6 poke window and also lets you answer his own Ignite all-in with burst of your own once you hit 6.

playing.title: Poke at max Q range
playing.detail: Parrrley outranges his auto and his E dash (450 range) by nearly 200 units — walk to 625, fire, and retreat before he can threaten anything back.

playing.title: Save W for his knockup chain
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears CC and heals — hold it specifically for the Searing Charge wall-collision shockwave or a redirected Call of the Forge God elemental, since either knockup is what lets his Ignite kill you.

playing.title: Respect level 6 near terrain
playing.detail: Once he hits 6, don't stand near walls with his E up — that's the exact setup for the knockup-into-Ignite kill OP.GG's own data warns about.

playing.title: Shove waves before 6
playing.detail: He has no way to punish a push before Searing Charge comes online, so crash the wave and force him to either eat tower shots or trade into your longer Q.

playing.title: Don't trade into his W gout
playing.detail: Bellows Breath's final flame applies Brittle on hit — wait out his charge-up before committing Parrrley so you're not trading into the empowered hit.

playing.title: Time E around his dead cooldowns
playing.detail: Pop Raise Morale's attack damage and move speed burst specifically when his Q or E is down, so the extra stats land on a trade he can't contest.

playing.title: Prioritize armor pen on schedule
playing.detail: His passive stacks bonus armor from every forged item, so don't delay Lord Dominik's Regards in your Essence Reaver build or your late-game damage falls off a cliff.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, summoners, and all win rates are measured OP.GG numbers from the current patch (16.19.1); the ability timing reads, cooldown windows, and trade patterns are my own analysis on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Although lane overall is easy, be careful of being killed when he reaches level 6 and uses (R) with ignite. Do not get propped airborne.
